thread:
tyler: quick ping — can someone take a look at PR #3429? It’s a Silverpine enterprise/private-deploy patch: fixes VPC route + nginx ingress annotations for the customer. Need an approval before tomorrow's maintenance window. https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/3429 :pray:

maria: @tyler grabbing it now :eyes:

jonathan: skimmed the terraform change, overall looks ok but left an inline about `idle_timeout` value — may want to bump it for flaky mounts

sudha: CI failing on the integration job `silverpine-deploy-e2e` — mounting step times out, past logs: `mount: timeout after 30s`

tyler: yep saw that. i'm going to push a small retry/timeout bump shortly

tyler: pushed `fix/mount-retry` — changed `idle_timeout = 30` -> `60`, added one retry loop

deploy-bot: CI started for PR #3429 (sha: abc123) — running unit + e2e

sudha: running a local e2e with the new commit, will report in ~15m

maria: also flagging nginx annotation: add `nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-read-timeout: "60"` else upstreams drop on long downloads — left suggestion in PR

jonathan: small note: please add a short runbook blurb for rollback steps (how to revert customer config/change) — I won't block on it but prefer it added before merge

deploy-bot: CI passed for PR #3429 — all checks ✅

sudha: local e2e green with the timeout bump, no regressions observed, :+1:

jonathan: Approved from my side, just one optional nit about comment wording

maria: Approved, good catch on the ingress timeout. recommend merging during maintenance window at 13:00 PST so Silverpine CSM can do validation afterwards

tyler: thanks — will update Silverpine runbook & notify CSM. tagging @ops to set the maintenance window and public downtime notice

ops: noted, scheduling the 13:00 PST window and will post the downtime in the customer portal + status page

tyler: merging now (will monitor logs for 30m post-deploy)

deploy-bot: PR #3429 merged into main (sha: def456) — deploy queued to staging then canary

maria: thanks y'all :tada: — please ping here if anything odd shows up in canary

tyler: will do — will follow up with the runbook link and postmortem checklist if any rollback required
